test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the underlined word in the following sentence.**

He was a __**liberal**__ who believed that men were inherently superior to women in every aspect of life.
solution:
The correct answer is **"conservative."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"liberal"** means accepting different opinions or kinds of behaviour; tolerant. (भिन्‍न मतों और व्‍यवहारों के प्रति उदार; सहिष्‍णु)

 
 
• **Example**: *He has a **liberal**__ parent.*
 
 
 
• Antonym of **"liberal"** is **"conservative."**
 
• The sentence suggests that the person believed in male superiority, which is not a liberal view.
 
• The word** "conservative"** means not liking change; traditional. (परिवर्तन का विरोधी; पारंपरिक, रूढ़िवादी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Even a **conservative**__ estimate would put the damage at about Rs 40,000 to repair.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (tolerant)** is not an appropriate antonym as it suggests acceptance and openness, which contradicts the belief in male superiority. (सहिष्‍णु, सहनशील (अरुचिकर या अस्‍वीकार्य वस्‍तु के प्रति))
 
• **Option 3 (republican)** is not relevant to the sentence as it refers to a political party and does not provide an antonym for **"liberal." **(गणतंत्र समर्थक व्‍यक्ति (जो सरकार और उसके नेता के निर्वाचित होने का समर्थन करे))
 
• **Option 4 (philanthropist)** is not an appropriate antonym as it refers to a person who donates money for charitable purposes and has no relation to the sentence. (दान आदि के द्वारा ज़रूरतमंदों की सहायता करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; परोपकारी व्‍यक्ति, लोकोपकारक)

33:T6b0,

The correct answer is **"learning."**
